name: tofu-harness
description: Harness discipline for AI agents. Say "set up the harness" to run /harness-setup — installs the stack in dependency order and proves each piece is live. /harness-help reports what you actually have and one next step. /install-hooks wires the verification gates in groups (core / recommended / full) and makes each one fire before reporting done. /harness-audit is a deadline-bounded census-verify-repair pass over your harness documents (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / SKILL.md / rules) after a model release. /tofable runs a task under the working discipline. Skill-only packaging — the gates under hooks/ install separately (see hooks/README.md).
